newsitem.title: FRANCE: French Q3 growth jumps, boosted by car buying.
newsitem.headline: French Q3 growth jumps, boosted by car buying.

text.p: France reported robust third-quarter economic growth on Thursday, boosted by a rush to buy cars ahead of the end to a state subsidy scheme.
Gross domestic product (GDP) rose 0.9 percent after a revised decline of 0.2 percent in the second quarter, national statistics institute INSEE reported.
It initially reported a 0.4 percent fall for the second quarter.
Third-quarter GDP had been expected to show a rise of 0.9 percent from the second quarter, according to a median forecast of 10 economists polled by Reuters.
Economists said the big contributor to third-quarter growth came from consumers scrambling to take advantage of a state car buying subsidy which ended on September 30.
